nodes.description: Public bool flag gating the public mint; toggled by flipSaleState and required true in mintBaddies.
Public bool flag gating the presale mint; toggled by flipPresaleState and required true in presaleMint.
Counter of total presale mints; incremented in presaleMint and constrained by MAX_PRESALE.
Randomized provenance index set once by setStartingIndex from a previous block hash; read by tokenURI.
Provenance hash string set by setProvenanceHash.
Constant cap of 8765 tokens enforced in reserveBaddies, mintBaddies and presaleMint.
Constant cap of 2346 presale tokens enforced in presaleMint.
Constant per-transaction limit of 10 tokens enforced in mintBaddies.
Constant per-address presale allocation of 3 enforced in presaleMint.
Constant price 0.08765 ether per token used to validate msg.value in mint and presale.
Constant number of reserved tokens (65) minted by the owner in reserveBaddies.
Mapping of addresses whitelisted for the presale; written by addToPresaleList/removeFromPresaleList and read by presaleMint/isPresaler.
Mapping of per-address presale purchase counts; incremented in presaleMint and read by presalePurchasedCount.
Owner address of the Ownable contract; the authority checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Owner-only function that toggles SALE_ACTIVE.
Owner-only function that toggles PRESALE_ACTIVE.
Owner-only function that adds entries to PRESALER_LIST with null/duplicate checks.
Owner-only function that removes entries from PRESALER_LIST.
Public view returning PRESALER_LIST[addr].
Public view returning PRESALE_PURCHASES[addr].
Owner-only function that transfers the contract balance to msg.sender via transfer.
Owner-only function that mints NUM_TO_RESERVE tokens to the caller if supply allows.
Payable public mint that enforces sale state, per-tx limit, supply cap and price before minting to msg.sender.
Payable presale mint enforcing whitelist, presale/supply caps, per-address allocation and price.
Owner-only function that sets STARTING_INDEX from blockhash(block.number - 1) modulo MAX_SUPPLY.
Owner-only function that sets the PROVENANCE string.
Owner-only function that sets the base URI through _setBaseURI.
View that returns the metadata URI, shifting token ids by STARTING_INDEX modulo MAX_SUPPLY.
Access-control modifier that requires owner() == _msgSender().
Owner-only function that transfers _owner to newOwner.
Owner-only function that sets _owner to the zero address.
Caller-controlled address; recipient of withdraw and of all minted tokens.
Block-level input used indirectly by setStartingIndex via blockhash/block.number.
External value transfer msg.sender.transfer(balance) performed in withdraw.
blockhash(block.number - 1) used as a randomness source for STARTING_INDEX (weak randomness).
Raw unchecked addition PRESALE_MINTED + numberOfTokens in presaleMint (0.6.x, no SafeMath).
Raw unchecked addition PRESALE_PURCHASES[msg.sender] + numberOfTokens in presaleMint.
numberOfTokens argument of mintBaddies.
numberOfTokens argument of presaleMint.
entries array argument of addToPresaleList.
entries array argument of removeFromPresaleList.
addr argument of isPresaler.
addr argument of presalePurchasedCount.
provenanceHash argument of setProvenanceHash.
baseURI argument of setBaseURI.
tokenId argument of tokenURI.
newOwner argument of transferOwnership.
supply local caching totalSupply() in mintBaddies.
supply local caching totalSupply() in presaleMint.
balance local caching address(this).balance in withdraw.
supply local caching totalSupply() in reserveBaddies.
id local computed as (tokenId + STARTING_INDEX) % MAX_SUPPLY in tokenURI.
entry local holding the current array element in addToPresaleList.

edges.reason: withdraw is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw performs an external ETH transfer to msg.sender.
Untrusted recipient can execute code during the value transfer.
Balances are sent to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
mintBaddies mints tokens directly to msg.sender.
presaleMint mints tokens directly to msg.sender.
SALE_ACTIVE must be true for mintBaddies to proceed.
PRESALE_ACTIVE must be true for presaleMint to proceed.
presaleMint requires PRESALER_LIST[msg.sender] to be true.
MAX_SUPPLY caps supply in mintBaddies.
MAX_SUPPLY caps the reserved mint in reserveBaddies.
MAX_PURCHASE limits tokens per mintBaddies call.
BADDIE_PRICE validates msg.value in mintBaddies.
NUM_TO_RESERVE is used by reserveBaddies.
MAX_PRESALE caps total presale mints.
MAX_PRESALE_PURCHASE caps per-address presale allocation.
PRESALE_MINTED is read and incremented in presaleMint.
PRESALE_PURCHASES is read and incremented in presaleMint.
presalePurchasedCount returns PRESALE_PURCHASES[addr].
isPresaler returns PRESALER_LIST[addr].
flipSaleState is owner-restricted.
flipPresaleState is owner-restricted.
addToPresaleList is owner-restricted.
removeFromPresaleList is owner-restricted.
reserveBaddies is owner-restricted.
setStartingIndex is owner-restricted.
setProvenanceHash is owner-restricted.
setBaseURI is owner-restricted.
transferOwnership is owner-restricted.
renounceOwnership is owner-restricted.
onlyOwner compares _owner with the caller.
transferOwnership reads _owner for the OwnershipTransferred event.
transferOwnership writes _owner, changing the privileged account.
renounceOwnership clears _owner.
setStartingIndex derives its value from blockhash(block.number - 1).
setStartingIndex writes STARTING_INDEX.
setStartingIndex requires STARTING_INDEX to be zero.
tokenURI uses STARTING_INDEX to shift token ids.
tokenURI reads STARTING_INDEX for id computation.
setProvenanceHash writes PROVENANCE.
presaleMint performs PRESALE_MINTED + numberOfTokens without SafeMath.
presaleMint performs PRESALE_PURCHASES[msg.sender] + numberOfTokens without SafeMath.
flipSaleState toggles SALE_ACTIVE.
flipPresaleState toggles PRESALE_ACTIVE.
addToPresaleList writes PRESALER_LIST entries.
removeFromPresaleList clears PRESALER_LIST entries.
setProvenanceHash writes the PROVENANCE state variable.
numberOfTokens parameter drives mintBaddies supply and price checks.
numberOfTokens parameter drives presaleMint cap and price checks.
entries array parameter is iterated in addToPresaleList.
entries array parameter is iterated in removeFromPresaleList.
addr parameter indexes PRESALER_LIST in isPresaler.
addr parameter indexes PRESALE_PURCHASES in presalePurchasedCount.
provenanceHash parameter is stored by setProvenanceHash.
baseURI parameter is passed to _setBaseURI.
tokenId parameter is used in tokenURI computation.
newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner in transferOwnership.
supply local feeds the mint loop in mintBaddies.
supply local feeds the mint loop in presaleMint.
balance local is the amount transferred in withdraw.
supply local feeds the reserve mint loop.
id local is returned by tokenURI.
entry local holds the iterated element in addToPresaleList.

String parameter stored directly into PROVENANCE.

Address parameter written into _owner by transferOwnership.

Local supply cache used only inside presaleMint.
